**What problem are you trying to solve?**
A clear description of the problem or workflow gap. Ex: "When I queue a long
playlist, I can't…"

---

**Before you file:** Tapedeck plays YouTube through the official embedded
player and Data API only. Requests for downloading, audio extraction, ad
blocking, or hidden playback of the stream will be declined — see the product
boundary in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).
